name: Margarita
source:
Margarita is a giant holstaurus (cow-girl) from Timfalme.
She is the owner of an inn placed on a road that connects the main city with one of the frontier walls, and she also owns a farm close to that place where she gets many of the products that she serves.
Even if she hired people to help her, Margarita is a hard worker and usually has her hands full with both her inn and her farm.
She strongly believes in "destiny" and thinks everything happens for a reason.
